stem: According to the World Health Organization (WHO), health is best described as
options: a state of complete physical, mental and social well-being
a state in which the body has no disease or infection at all
a state of physical fitness gained through daily exercise
a state of mental peace reached through daily meditation
explanation: Correct option: (A). WHO defines health as a state of complete physical, mental and social well-being, and not merely the absence of disease. Option (B) is exactly the 'absence of disease' idea that the definition says is not enough. Options (C) and (D) each describe only one aspect (physical or mental) of health.

stem: Ravi eats a balanced diet and plays football every day, but he has no friends at his new school and feels lonely and upset most of the time. Which statement about Ravi is correct?

stem: When the body meets a pathogen for the second time, its immune response is much stronger than the first time. The best explanation is that
